title: Meta-label + early exit on timeframe-break trades: can other layers pick the winners, and does getting out early help?

what.name: Trades
what.value_plain: tf_break events (break of a prior-period high/low; classes H follow, R reclaim, W1 wick-sweep fade), BTCUSDT 15m / 1h / 4h, entry at the open of the bar after the signal, exit at the close 4 bars later
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10 % round trip (taker both legs), no slippage, no funding
what.label: OURS

what.name: Filter
what.value_plain: logistic score (L2 1.0) from 15 readings at entry: BBWP (basis 7, lookback 100) on the trade TF and 4h, daily trend, RSI, taker flow, relative volume, distance to level, move since break, realised vol, session, setup class
what.label: OURS

what.name: Early exit
what.value_plain: exit at the close of bar 1 or 2 if not in profit, else hold the 4 bars
what.label: OURS

how: Scored every trade out of fold (6 purged time blocks, 7-day purge, score cut from the training fold), compared the best third with all trades; 200 label shuffles as placebo, Holm over 3 timeframes, week-block bootstrap CI. Rules frozen in PRE_REG.md before any result.
window: DEV only, 2022-01 to 2024-06 (trades before about 2022-07-19 dropped: daily SMA200 warm-up); VALIDATION and HOLDOUT not read
why: 15m: best third -0.080 % per trade after fees, placebo p 0.090, Holm p 0.129 -> FAIL
1h: best third +0.063 % per trade after fees, placebo p 0.020, Holm p 0.060 -> INCONCLUSIVE
4h: best third +0.097 % per trade after fees, placebo p 0.065, Holm p 0.129 -> FAIL

Early exit: every difference CI includes zero. After one bar about 28 % of eventual winners are still under water and about 65 % of losers, so "not in profit yet" cuts winners almost as often as losers.
1h lead: best third positive in both halves (+0.129 / +0.035 %); next check is 2019-2021 data never seen (card meta-label-1h-dev-ext-check).
